title: Breanne Taylor’s CV
text:
Accounting Student | Data Science Certificate

beezerwee@gmail.com | (208) 243-4178 LinkedIn



Accounting student at Brigham Young University–Idaho with a focus on data analytics and taxation, working toward building real-world experience and professional growth.


Accounting fundamentals, data analytics, Python, SQL, Power BI



Income taxation, data analytics, problem solving, applying data science to business decisions




September 2023 - Present Brigham Young University–Idaho, Rexburg, Idaho

Accounting Major

GPA: 3.90 | Major GPA: 4.0

Data Science Certification




April 2025 - September 2025 Broulim’s Fresh Foods, Rigby, Idaho
Cashier

Operated cash register and POS system accurately during high-volume hours

Trained 6 new employees on transactions and payment procedures

Reconciled cash drawer daily and identified discrepancies

Maintained drawer accuracy within $1 on nearly every shift

Handled ~150 customer transactions per shift efficiently

August 2023 - December 2023 Aspen Home Health and Hospice, Idaho Falls, Idaho
Home Health and Hospice Aid

Performed CNA duties while traveling between patients

Assisted with daily living activities and patient care

Documented care for 1–7 patients per shift

Monitored and recorded vital signs consistently

June 2023 - September 2023 Sage Grove Assisted Living, Rigby, Idaho
Certified Nursing Assistant

Assisted residents with hygiene, mobility, and daily care

Supported 10–14 patients per shift with individualized care

Maintained detailed documentation of health and preferences

Ensured compliance with health and safety regulations

Prepared meals for residents with dietary restrictions





CPR

Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)

Microsoft Word and Excel

ServSafe Food Handler Permit






Python, SQL, Microsoft Power BI, AI Prompting



Teamwork, Attention to Detail, Organization, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving




Committed to gaining hands-on experience and contributing value in every role, while building a strong foundation for long-term professional growth.
